description: List the upcoming public deadlines (open and announced) in date order, with their type. open_call is true only for open submission and application calls; registration and decision dates are listed with their type and are never open calls. Set open_calls_only to list open calls only. Filter by research field, category key, world region, and date range. Returns at most 20 deadlines per call; use next_offset for the next page.

description: Search upcoming academic conferences, workshops and calls for papers by words in the title, organizer, location, field, date or topic. Pass 1 to 4 short topic, organizer or place words (for example 'macroeconomics Europe' or 'corporate finance'); omit filler words such as 'conferences', 'CFP', 'call for papers' or 'upcoming'. Optionally filter by research field, world region, or open calls only. Returns at most 10 events with their ResearchCal page and official source URL.
